notes: «عن جده الحسين بن راشد» is one link with the name alone (rule 7); the first «جده» is absorbed into that name
«حدثني أبي عن جده عن آبائه» continues the chain after the Imam «أبي عبد الله» (who stays a narrator, since he sits after «عن»); Ali is the last link
«أبي ره» and «ره» blessings are stripped; occurrence numbers count the word «أبي» in the text, including inside «أبي بصير» and «أبي عبد الله»
